11. In case (a): advance = true, develop = true, collaborate = false.  No contradiction arises with contributes = true or false; however, nothing forces contributes = true. Therefore across all models consistent with the context, we are never required to have studies marine life = true; indeed in at least one model it must be false.  Hence the statement is not entailed.
